text: You found that perfect software, promising to simplify your life. Signing up was a breeze: a few clicks, and your new digital tool was ready.
Months pass. You're busy, using the software casually. Then, out of nowhere, a charge appears on your statement. A surprise auto-renewal.
You think, 'Did I forget to cancel?' You scold yourself for not keeping track, feeling foolish for missing the deadline.
But it's not just you. This system is designed to capture inertia, gently nudging you past the cancellation point.
That forgotten renewal isn't a bug; it's a feature. Companies bank on you valuing convenience more than the effort to actively stop.
Next time you sign up, you'll see the invisible system working. You'll understand the quiet incentive and act with clear intention.
